The '''Notonia system''' was located in the [[Illisurevimurasi sector/Legends|Illisurevimurasi sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TransHydian" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the creatures known as [[Notonian mudworm]]s.<ref name="ApproachingStorm" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Notonia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-4.<ref name="TEA" />
